# Raffles Residences Jakarta

> Ultra-luxury branded residence at Ciputra World 1, Kuningan, Jakarta Selatan. 88 units, 4 bedroom, 470 sqm, private lift, butler service. Managed by Accor (Raffles Hotels & Resorts).

## Property Overview

- Property Name: Raffles Residences Jakarta
- Type: Branded Residence / Ultra-Luxury Apartment
- Location: Ciputra World 1, Jl. Prof. Dr. Satrio Kav. 3-5, Karet Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan 12940, Indonesia
- Area: Segitiga Emas (Golden Triangle) Jakarta — bounded by Jl. Sudirman, Gatot Subroto, Rasuna Said
- Coordinates: -6.2267, 106.8231
- Total Units: 88
- Units Per Floor: 4
- Floor Range: 26th to 60th floor
- Bedrooms: 4 + Maid Room (all units)
- Status: Completed and operational (secondary market units available)

## Developer & Design Team

- Developer: PT Ciputra Property Tbk (subsidiary of Ciputra Group)
- Architect: RTKL, Baltimore, USA (now part of CallisonRTKL)
- Interior Designer: HBA Singapore (Hirsch Bedner Associates)
- Hotel Operator: Accor — Raffles Hotels & Resorts brand
- Hotel Component: Raffles Jakarta (174 rooms and suites)

## Pricing

- Sale Price Range: IDR 25,000,000,000 — IDR 30,000,000,000 (25B — 30B)
- Price Per SQM: Approximately IDR 52,000,000 — IDR 63,000,000/sqm (semigross)
- Currency: Indonesian Rupiah (IDR)
- Availability: Secondary market from existing owners

## Specifications

- Floor: High quality marble throughout; Greek marble walls and floors in all bathrooms; pattern marble in foyer lift lobby and master bathroom
- Kitchen Cabinet: Bofie (Italy) with marble top
- Kitchen Appliances: Miele (Germany) — induction cooktop, combi oven, extractor hood
- Kitchen Sink: Hansgrohe
- Kitchen Tap: Franke (Switzerland)
- Sanitary Fixtures: Duravit and Hansgrohe
- Dimming System: Lutron (living & dining areas)
- Electrical Outlets: Berker
- Air Conditioning: Daikin ducted system with architectural drop ceiling
- Doors: Timber double door with high gloss veneer finish (main entrance); timber with duco painting (bedrooms); timber louvre with duco (bathrooms)
- Windows/Facade: Mullion system with double laminated glass
- Balcony: 6m aluminium folding door, 1.35m glass balustrade
- Features: Motion sensor entry lighting, electrically powered curtains, video call to reception

## Security

- Dedicated entrance and lobby separate from hotel
- 24-hour manned private entrance
- Private key-controlled lift per apartment (security access cards)
- Security checkpoints and surveillance systems
- Building exceeds Indonesian Government seismic regulations

## Ciputra World 1 Jakarta Complex

Raffles Residences sits atop the Raffles Tower within the Ciputra World 1 Jakarta superblock development, which includes:
- Ciputra World 1 Office Tower (40 floors)
- Lotte Mall Jakarta (formerly Lotte Shopping Avenue) — 130,000 sqm retail
- Ciputra Artpreneur — Art Museum, Art Gallery, 1,200-seat Auditorium
- Ascott Serviced Residences
- myHome at Ciputra World 1 Apartments
- DBS Bank Tower

- Mega Kuningan CBD: 5 minutes drive
- Jl. Sudirman: 5 minutes drive
- SCBD: 10 minutes drive
- Rasuna Said: 5 minutes drive
- Foreign Embassies (multiple): Walking distance
- TransJakarta bus stop: In front of Lotte Mall
